packageRules.description: Block automatic TYPO3 framework major upgrades; majors require manual scope review with a code migration and passing tests (extension supports ^13.4 || ^14.3, see ext_emconf.php). Pattern ^typo3/cms- also covers typo3/cms-composer-installers. See PR #28 / PRs #34-36 for prior incidents where Renovate raised an unmigrated, unverified v14 bump that had to be reverted.
